subject: Intro + 20m walkthrough to review inference ops (usage spike)
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ayla Khan <ayla@brightmode.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Intro + 20m walkthrough to review inference ops (usage spike)

Hi Ayla —

Congrats on the recent usage jump — I can see BrightMode crossed our 1.5M token/month threshold this week. That usually means customers benefit from a quick 20-minute runthrough so we can:
- confirm your current routing & batching settings
- review suggestions to reduce per-token cost without regressions
- highlight any security/compliance questions you have for Private/Dedicated options

If that sounds useful I can pull in Ben (solutions engineer) for a brief technical walkthrough. Here are two ways to book:
- Pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/20min-walkthrough
- Or reply with 2 windows that work for you and I’ll coordinate

Attached is a short agenda and our one-page security brief in case you want to share with engineering/security folks ahead of time.

Thanks — talk soon,
Mateo Alvarez
SDR, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0126

Attachments: redwood-20m-walkthrough-agenda.pdf (1 page), security-brief.pdf (4 pages)

Hi Mateo —

Thanks — yes the spike is intentional as we ramp a new feature. A short walkthrough would be great. I have the following windows tomorrow (PT):

- 1:30–2:00pm

We do have a couple security items to surface (data residency question + audit log retention). Can Ben join? Also can you share any docs I can forward to our security lead?

—Ayla
Ayla Khan

ayla@brightmode.ai
